versions.changelog: R20 upgrade 1.3.4: align judgment, evidence and trust boundaries; regression fixes and release checks. Validation limits and remaining issues are documented in the bundled CHANGELOG.md.

R17 alignment folded into the role-packs: composer spec-boundary step (adversarial precedents on load-bearing clauses; reject codebase-to-spec reverse authorship; 89% compliance ceiling), engineer verifier-engineering discipline + loop-charter gate for loop-type skills, guidance per-surface branches (tool/action/memory). Conductor gate logic untouched; five L0 gates green.

The skill-building pipeline as ONE thin-conductor skill, replacing the old four-skill pipeline (guidance/engineer/zipper/conductor). Runs standalone (KB is external design-time provenance). Live-tested building two real skills end-to-end with an independent battery.
